summary: Router 0.22.0 bounds authenticated traffic per client (ADR-0063). auth.client_auth_middleware, after identity, rate limit and inference refusal, applies client_limits(spec) for a configured client: a declared Content-Length above max_body_mib (default 16 MiB) is answered 413 before the handler; with max_concurrent (default 4) requests of the client already in progress the next one gets 429 with Retry-After: 1 before any work; otherwise the in-progress counter is raised and given back in a finally block, also when the client disconnects and the handler is cancelled. The router's own UI identity is not a configured client and is not limited. config.py validates max_concurrent (1-256) and max_body_mib (1-64) as integers (booleans and strings refused) and adds them to the schema; admin.py and settings.py expose them in the UI with German and English labels; metrics.py exports skirnir_client_inflight, skirnir_client_peak_inflight, skirnir_client_concurrency_limited_total and skirnir_client_too_large_total. Refusals are audited (concurrency_limited, body_too_large) with client, path and limit, never content. Chunked bodies without a declared length stay bounded by the app ceiling of 64 MiB. Breaking for clients that run more than 4 requests at once: they need a higher max_concurrent before the upgrade.

findings.evidence: An authenticated client was bounded by requests per minute and the 64 MiB app ceiling only; its requests in progress were unbounded.
findings.resolution: Per-client concurrency and declared size bounds with defaults and peak gauges. Chunked bodies, per-client cost and hostile-load budgets remain open.

tests.evidence: 7 tests OK: fifth concurrent request 429 with Retry-After and no work, per-client slots, 413 above 16 MiB unless 32 allowed, slot returned after disconnect, config bounds, UI fields, gauges.
